title: Daily set · Nov 27
title_zh: 每日新题 · 11 月 27 日
summary: Five new agent questions: memory that overrules the merchant's current request, AI-written HTML that ran a script on the storefront, a slow export tool that the agent started four times, review questions that need counting instead of top-k retrieval, and capacity planning for Black Friday.
summary_zh: 五道新的 Agent 题：推翻商家当前要求的记忆、在店铺前台执行了脚本的 AI 生成 HTML、被 Agent 启动了四次的慢速导出工具、需要统计而不是 Top-k 检索的评论问题，以及黑五的容量规划。

questions.title: The copywriting assistant keeps using the formal German "Sie" a merchant asked for in April, ignores today's request for casual copy, and then overwrites the saved preference with a guess
questions.title_zh: 文案助手一直沿用商家 4 月要求的德语敬称「Sie」，无视今天要用随意语气的要求，后来又用一个猜测覆盖了已保存的偏好
questions.question:
The ad-copy assistant has long-term memory. In April a merchant said "always address German customers formally", and the assistant saved it. Today the merchant asked for casual copy for a TikTok campaign aimed at students; the assistant still wrote formal copy, citing the saved rule. After the merchant complained twice, the assistant updated memory to "merchant prefers casual German", and next week's formal newsletter came out casual.

What is wrong with how this memory works, and how would you fix it?
questions.question_zh:
广告文案助手有长期记忆。4 月时，一位商家说「对德国顾客一律使用敬称」，助手把它保存了下来。今天，这位商家为一个面向学生的 TikTok 广告系列要求写随意风格的文案；助手却依然写成了正式语气，理由是那条已保存的规则。商家抱怨了两次之后，助手把记忆改成了「商家偏好随意的德语」，结果下周正式的新闻邮件也变成了随意风格。

这套记忆机制哪里出了问题？你会怎样修复？
followups: Two staff members of the same store give conflicting standing preferences. Whose wins?
How would you write an eval that catches a memory overruling the merchant's current request?
When should a memory expire on its own?
followups_zh: 同一家店铺的两名员工给出了相互冲突的长期偏好。以谁的为准？
你会如何编写一个评测，来抓住记忆推翻商家当前要求的情况？
一条记忆在什么情况下应当自动过期？

questions.title: AI-written product descriptions are published as HTML, and one copied an image tag with an onerror script from a supplier's page onto the storefront
questions.title_zh: AI 撰写的商品描述以 HTML 形式发布，其中一条把供应商页面上带 onerror 脚本的图片标签照搬到了店铺前台
questions.question: The catalog agent reads a supplier's product page and writes a description for the merchant's storefront. To keep formatting, the team asks the model for HTML and inserts it into the product page as is. A security researcher reported that one jacket's description contained `` that sent shoppers' cookies to another domain. The text came from the supplier's page; the model copied it into a feature list. Explain the vulnerability and design the fix.
questions.question_zh: 目录 Agent 读取供应商的商品页面，并为商家的店铺前台撰写描述。为了保留格式，团队让模型输出 HTML，并原样插入商品页面。一位安全研究员报告说，有一件夹克的描述里包含 ``，会把顾客的 cookie 发送到另一个域名。这段文字来自供应商的页面；模型把它抄进了一个功能列表里。 解释这个漏洞，并设计修复方案。
questions.answer:
**The core idea.** Model output is untrusted input, exactly like text from a form. The model read attacker-controlled content, so anything it writes may contain attacker-controlled content. The bug is not that the model copied a tag; it is that the storefront executed whatever the model produced. **Why prompts cannot fix it.** "Never output scripts" lowers the rate but cannot guarantee zero, and an attacker can hide payloads that look harmless to a reader, such as event handlers or `javascript:` links. This is a classic stored cross-site scripting bug with a new source. A second model that screens the output has the same weakness: a probabilistic filter in front of a page that executes whatever reaches it. **Fix one: never let the model write markup.** Ask for structured text with structured outputs (`output_config.format`) and let your template produce the HTML. Go's `html/template` escapes text by context: ```go // Description is what the model returns (via structured outputs): text only, // no HTML. The storefront decides the markup, and the template escapes text. type Description struct { Intro string `json:"intro"` Features []string `json:"features"` Care string `json:"care"` } var page = template.Must(template.New("d").Parse( `

{{.Intro}}

    {{range .Features}}
  • {{.}}
    • {{end}}

{{.Care}}

`)) ``` In a local run, the copied tag was rendered as visible text, `<img src=x onerror=...>`, and `&` in the care line became `&`. Nothing the model writes can become a tag. **Fix two: layers for what must stay rich.** If merchants need bold text or links, accept a small markup subset and convert it with an allowlist sanitizer on the server: a few tags, no attributes except checked `href` values with `https` only. Add a Content Security Policy on the storefront that forbids inline scripts, so a missed payload still does not run. **Clean up and detect.** - Scan every stored description for tags and `javascript:` URLs, re-render them through the new path, and check which shoppers loaded the affected pages. - Treat the supplier page as hostile input to the agent too: it is also a prompt-injection channel, and text there may try to change what the agent does, not just what it writes. - Add eval cases with poisoned supplier pages and assert that rendered output contains no executable markup. **Trade-offs.** Structured fields limit layout freedom; most product pages need only paragraphs and bullet lists. A strict CSP can break third-party widgets on the storefront, so roll it out in report-only mode first.
questions.answer_zh:
**核心思想。** 模型的输出是不可信的输入，和表单里提交的文字完全一样。模型读取了攻击者控制的内容，所以它写出的任何东西都可能包含攻击者控制的内容。bug 并不在于模型抄了一个标签，而在于店铺前台会执行模型产出的任何东西。 **为什么提示词修不好它。** 「绝不输出脚本」能降低发生的频率，却无法保证为零；而且攻击者可以把载荷藏在读者看来无害的地方，比如事件处理属性或 `javascript:` 链接。这是一个经典的存储型跨站脚本漏洞，只是来源换了。再加一个模型来审查输出，也有同样的弱点：它是一个概率性的过滤器，挡在一个会执行一切到达内容的页面前面。 **修复一：绝不让模型编写标记。** 通过结构化输出（`output_config.format`）要求模型给出结构化的文本，再由你自己的模板生成 HTML。Go 的 `html/template` 会根据上下文对文本做转义： ```go // Description is what the model returns (via structured outputs): text only, // no HTML. The storefront decides the markup, and the template escapes text. type Description struct { Intro string `json:"intro"` Features []string `json:"features"` Care string `json:"care"` } var page = template.Must(template.New("d").Parse( `

{{.Intro}}

    {{range .Features}}
  • {{.}}
    • {{end}}

{{.Care}}

`)) ``` 在一次本地运行中，被抄进来的标签以可见文字的形式渲染成 `<img src=x onerror=...>`，护理说明里的 `&` 也变成了 `&`。模型写的任何东西都无法变成标签。 **修复二：对必须保留富文本的部分做多层防护。** 如果商家需要粗体或链接，就只接受一个很小的标记子集，并在服务端用白名单净化器转换：只允许少数几个标签，除了经过检查、且只允许 `https` 的 `href` 之外不允许任何属性。再在店铺前台加上禁止内联脚本的内容安全策略（CSP），这样即使有漏网的载荷也不会执行。 **清理与检测。** - 扫描所有已存储的描述，查找标签和 `javascript:` URL，用新链路重新渲染它们，并排查哪些顾客加载过受影响的页面。 - 也要把供应商页面视为对 Agent 有敌意的输入：它同样是一个提示词注入的渠道，那里的文字可能试图改变 Agent 的行为，而不仅仅是它写出的内容。 - 加入带有恶意内容的供应商页面作为评测用例，并断言渲染后的输出不包含任何可执行的标记。 **权衡。** 结构化字段限制了排版的自由度；不过大多数商品页面只需要段落和项目列表。严格的 CSP 可能会破坏店铺前台上的第三方组件，所以先以仅报告模式上线。
followups: The same descriptions are also sent to Google Merchant Center and to email templates. What changes for each output?
How would you let merchants paste their own HTML safely?
followups_zh: 同样的描述还会发送到 Google Merchant Center 和邮件模板。对每种输出分别有什么不同？
你会如何让商家安全地粘贴他们自己的 HTML？

questions.title: The catalog-export tool takes eight minutes, the tool call times out after 60 seconds, and the agent starts the same export three more times
questions.title_zh: 目录导出工具需要 8 分钟，工具调用在 60 秒后超时，于是 Agent 又把同一个导出任务启动了三次
questions.question:
Merchants ask the assistant to "export my catalog for Google". The `export_catalog` tool calls an internal API that builds the feed file and returns its URL. For large stores that takes about eight minutes, but the tool handler waits only 60 seconds and then returns "Error: timeout". The model, seeing an error, calls the tool again. The export service never stopped the first job, so the largest merchants got four exports running at once and the feed service slowed for everyone.

Redesign the tool.
questions.question_zh:
商家会让助手「把我的商品目录导出给 Google」。`export_catalog` 工具会调用一个内部 API，由它生成 feed 文件并返回文件的 URL。对于大店铺，这大约需要 8 分钟，可工具的处理程序只等 60 秒，然后就返回「Error: timeout」。模型看到报错，就再次调用工具。导出服务从未停掉第一个任务，于是最大的那些商家同时有四个导出在跑，feed 服务对所有人都变慢了。

重新设计这个工具。
followups: The merchant asks to cancel the export halfway. What does the tool set look like now?
How would you show progress in the chat without the model calling the status tool every few seconds?
Which other tools in a catalog agent should become jobs, and which should stay synchronous?
followups_zh: 商家要求中途取消导出。现在工具集应该是什么样子？
你会如何在聊天里展示进度，又不让模型每隔几秒就调用一次状态工具？
目录 Agent 里还有哪些工具应当改成任务式？哪些应当保持同步？

questions.title: "Does this jacket run small?" The assistant quotes three angry reviews, while 700 of 800 reviewers say the fit is true to size
questions.title_zh: 「这件夹克偏小吗？」助手引用了三条愤怒的评论，而 800 位评论者中有 700 位说尺码标准
questions.question:
The shopping assistant answers product questions with retrieval over customer reviews: it embeds the question, fetches the five most similar reviews and answers from them. Asked whether a jacket runs small, it said "several customers found it too tight, consider sizing up" and quoted three reviews. Returns for that jacket rose after the assistant launched. A manual check found that about 90% of reviews that mention fit call it true to size.

Explain why retrieval failed here and design a better approach.
questions.question_zh:
购物助手通过对顾客评论做检索来回答商品问题：它对问题做嵌入，取出最相似的 5 条评论，再据此作答。被问到一件夹克是否偏小时，它说「好几位顾客觉得太紧了，建议选大一码」，并引用了三条评论。助手上线后，这件夹克的退货增加了。人工核查发现，在提到尺码的评论中，约 90% 说尺码标准。

解释这里的检索为什么失败，并设计一个更好的方法。
followups: How would you handle a jacket whose fit changed after the supplier switched factories in the spring?
A shopper asks a question none of your extracted attributes covers. What happens?
How would you measure whether the new answers reduce returns?
followups_zh: 供应商春天换了工厂之后，一件夹克的尺码发生了变化。你会怎么处理？
顾客问了一个你抽取的属性都没有覆盖到的问题。会发生什么？
你会如何衡量新的回答是否减少了退货？

questions.title: Black Friday is three weeks away: capacity planning for the shopper chat agent, from token forecasts and rate limits to what to switch off first
questions.title_zh: 距离黑五还有三周：为顾客聊天 Agent 做容量规划，从 token 预测、速率限制，到先关掉哪些功能
questions.question:
Last Black Friday the shopper chat agent hit rate limits for two hours: shoppers saw errors, and the bulk product-description jobs that ran at the same time made it worse. This year traffic is forecast to be higher, the agent now runs on Claude Opus 5.5, and leadership wants a plan that keeps chat working at peak.

Walk through how you would plan capacity and degradation.
questions.question_zh:
去年黑五，顾客聊天 Agent 撞上速率限制长达两个小时：顾客看到了报错，同时在跑的批量商品描述任务又让情况雪上加霜。今年的流量预计会更高，Agent 现在运行在 Claude Opus 5.5 上，管理层希望有一个能让聊天在高峰期正常工作的方案。

讲讲你会如何规划容量和降级。
followups: How would you load-test the agent without paying for a full Black Friday of tokens?
Which metrics would trigger each step of the degradation ladder?
Would you consider fast mode for this peak? What would it change, and what would it not?
followups_zh: 你会如何对 Agent 做压测，又不用为一整天黑五规模的 token 付费？
哪些指标会触发降级阶梯的每一级？
你会考虑在这次高峰期使用 fast mode 吗？它会改变什么，又不会改变什么？
